packs.title: The concepts, and what the evidence says about them
packs.job: Understand the concepts · see the evidence
packs.who: The author, an editor, or a reviewing agent who has read nothing else
packs.lead: The vocabulary this book is being built out of, what the twenty-one carried source documents actually say about it, where the material contradicts itself, and what is still unanswered. Assembled in one sequence so that none of it depends on clicking through a website.
